validated_product.standardized_title: Schneider Electric PowerPact H- and J-Frame Molded Case Circuit Breakers
validated_product.marketing_description: The Schneider Electric PowerPact H- and J-Frame Molded Case Circuit Breakers deliver industry-leading reliability and flexible circuit protection. Designed for thermal-magnetic and electronic trip versatility, these current-limiting breakers offer interchangeable trip units and a wide range of interrupting ratings up to 100 kA at 480 Vac. Ideal for heavy-duty industrial, commercial, and marine applications, they ensure robust performance and seamless integration into electrical distribution systems.
bullet_points: UL Certified current-limiting performance for J and L interrupting levels
Field-interchangeable thermal-magnetic and Micrologic electronic trip units
Amperage ratings spanning 15 A to 150 A (H-Frame) and 150 A to 250 A (J-Frame)
Versatile termination options including standard lugs, I-Line, plug-in, and drawout configurations
Available with UL Marine and Naval listings for specialized vessel applications
